name: Family Budget
description: An envelope-lite family budget, unique per placement: money in, money out, categorized, one month at a time. Space editors record income and expenses against channel-colored category envelopes, set a monthly budget per envelope, and step through months to watch spending fill each bar. Everyone else, including anyone the frame is shared with publicly, sees a live read-only view of the month. Categories and transactions live in encrypted LocalTables scoped to the placement, every change is pushed live to all viewers, and the owner can graduate a placement's data to shared tables so other frames can bind the same rows.
